# DECOBAY Interiors

> Architectural & interior design firm based in San Ramon, California, creating warm, timeless residential and commercial interiors across the East Bay and San Francisco Bay Area.

DECOBAY Interiors (DECOBAY Interiors LLC, 3032 Promontory Cir, San Ramon, CA 94583) offers full-home and architectural design, construction documentation, procurement and furniture sourcing, commercial spaces, single-room refreshes and project management. Service area: San Ramon, Danville, Dublin, Pleasanton, Walnut Creek, Alamo, Lafayette, Livermore and the wider Bay Area. BBB Accredited Business. Free 30-minute consultations are booked online.

## Pages

- [Home](https://decobayinteriors.com/): Studio overview, philosophy, selected projects, services and free consultation booking.
- [Projects](https://decobayinteriors.com/links): Index of residential and commercial projects.
- [Palmetto Berkeley](https://decobayinteriors.com/berkeley): Architecture and interiors project in Berkeley, CA.
- [Palmetto San Ramon](https://decobayinteriors.com/palmetto): Commercial architecture project in San Ramon, CA.
- [Kat & Adam](https://decobayinteriors.com/katAndAdam): Kitchen remodel.
- [Opera Plaza](https://decobayinteriors.com/operaplaza): Bathroom remodel in San Francisco.
- [Sarita residence](https://decobayinteriors.com/sarita): Residential project with photo gallery and 3D walkthrough.
- [Hardscape](https://decobayinteriors.com/hardscape): Outdoor hardscape and pool project.
- [SHOOTZ](https://decobayinteriors.com/shootz): Commercial build-out.
